2608.18423.title: FM-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Management with Competing Agents
2608.18423.paper_summary: Language model agents now execute bounded tasks reliably. Whether they can sustain effective decision-making over long horizons, where actions have cumulative consequences and the environment responds to their choices, remains largely unmeasured. FM-Bench (Football Management Benchmark) measures this. An LLM agent runs a football club for 20 in-game years through 26 tools and roughly 340 to 400 decision stops. It drafts a squad on the same budget as every rival, trades players, negotiates contracts, invests in facilities and youth, sets lineups, and answers to a board that can fire it, while a deterministic engine accumulates every year into one final score with no LLM judge or human rater. The solo track plays each of 15 frontier models against a frozen scripted world, and the Arena places the same models plus a scripted anchor in one shared 20-year world; to our knowledge, the first head-to-head evaluation at this scale. We measure six behavioral capabilities behind the score. Across three seeds, all 15 models complete every horizon while the blind scripted baselines die out in most of theirs, and claude-fable-5 tops the solo board on mean score and the Arena, where the title nonetheless rotates among ten models. Neither scale, price, nor vendor predicts the order; the order settles only late in the horizon, and the best first-play human lands only at the bottom of the model board. What separates the models is managerial behavior rather than computation. Higher-scoring models reduce slow-payoff investment near the end, keep cash invested rather than idle, and open renewals well before the deadline, while token spend predicts nothing. No model learns the market's hidden prices from hundreds of rejected bids, and self-managed memory fails in two opposite modes: an archive that only grows or a plan rewritten every season. Code is available at https://github.com/Analogy-AI/fm-bench.
2608.18423.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型代理現在可以可靠地執行有限的任務。它們是否能在長期內持續有效的決策，尤其是在行動具有累積後果且環境會對其選擇做出反應的情況下，仍然大多未被測量。FM-Bench（足球管理基準）測量這一點。一個LLM代理通過26個工具和大約340到400個決策停頓，運營一個足球俱樂部20個遊戲年。它在與每個對手相同的預算下選擇球隊，交易球員，談判合同，投資設施和青訓，設置陣容，並對一個可以解雇它的董事會負責，同時一個確定性引擎每年累積成一個最終得分，沒有LLM評審或人類評分者。獨立賽道將15個前沿模型與一個凍結的腳本世界進行對抗，而競技場則將相同的模型加上一個腳本錨點放置在一個共享的20年世界中；據我們所知，這是首次在這一規模下進行的正面評估。我們衡量得分背後的六種行為能力。在三個種子中，所有15個模型在每個時間範圍內都完成了任務，而盲目的腳本基線在大多數情況下則無法生存，claude-fable-5在平均得分和競技場上名列獨立榜首，儘管該頭銜在十個模型之間輪流。無論是規模、價格還是供應商都無法預測順序；這一順序僅在時間範圍的後期確定，而最佳的首次遊玩人類僅位於模型榜單的底部。區分這些模型的是管理行為而非計算。得分較高的模型在結尾時減少慢回報的投資，保持現金投資而非閒置，並在截止日期之前提前開啟續約，而代幣支出則無法預測任何結果。沒有模型能從數百個被拒絕的出價中學習市場的隱藏價格，自我管理的記憶在兩種相反的模式中失敗：一個僅增長的檔案或每個賽季重寫的計劃。代碼可在 https://github.com/Analogy-AI/fm-bench 獲取。
